marker_format.name: one of marker_vocabulary
marker_format.event_id: provided at playback by resolver event; never authored damage
marker_format.order: windup_start <= hit/cast <= recover_start <= recover_end; projectile_spawn/vfx_spawn may be at their authored visual phases

authority: Combat resolver event ID and timestamp are authoritative. Clips/markers never calculate, apply, roll, repeat or undo damage. A marker only requests visual/audio presentation.

synchronization.attack: Fit anticipation/contact/recovery to event timeline without changing event time. If too short, shorten/reduce presentation or use fallback impact; do not delay damage.
synchronization.projectile: Travel VFX to authoritative impact time; no physics collision authority.
synchronization.interrupt: KO cancels outgoing presentation and pending cosmetic markers; already-resolved damage is never rolled back.
synchronization.seek_replay: Reconstruct state at target time; suppress historical one-shot sounds/VFX. Deduplicate by event ID and cue kind.
synchronization.dodge: Show only on authoritative dodge event; clip motion never changes dodge probability.
synchronization.reflected_damage: Reaction follows reflected event, no recursive attack animation generated.
synchronization.missing_clip: Log contract error and use neutral/reaction fallback; do not block simulation.

locomotion: Optional later walk/run clips use the same contract; not required while combat remains non-spatial. No jump, flight, taunt or ultimate added without shared need.
export: Separate named actions, baked at 30 fps; no strip suffix, automatic .001 names or exporter loop-name suffix. Loop flags live in this contract/import adapter.
verification: v1.18 validates specification names and marker schemas only. First GLB must prove actual clip presence/loops/rest/root-motion and runtime event synchronization in v1.19.
